scope: Integration and regression verification; no application source fixes or UI redesigns were needed.

workflow_tests.ai_mode: Mocked model responses; fixture usage values are not reported as provider usage.
coverage_added: House Rules preference updates and persistence
Unanimous activation, duplicate-vote prevention, rejection, change requests, and revision approval reset
Household isolation and chore completion persistence

browser_verification.house_rules_to_house_board: passed; the Board analysis retrieved the active kitchen rule, requested clarification where needed, and created an approval request with a linked notification
browser_verification.notifications_and_approvals: passed; read state updated and the request completed only after the additional roommate approval
browser_verification.mediation_agents: passed; Listening, Mediation, and Agreement agents ran, the Mediation Agent retrieved the active rule, and the agreement remained pending at one approval then activated at two
browser_verification.chores_and_bills: passed; chore completion persisted after refresh and the temporary completion toggle was reverted; sample splits were $68 / 4 = $17 and $42.60 / 4 = $10.65
browser_verification.browser_issue: One Chrome autofill suggestion: the roommate profile select has an accessible label but no id/name. It remains operable and labeled; no workflow failure was found.
browser_verification.screenshots: Could not export browser captures with the available browser interface; manual capture is needed for screenshot artifacts.

database_integrity.cold_process_reopen: passed; a fresh Python process initialized the backend against the same isolated database and read the persisted household, feature records, and AI logs
database_integrity.fresh_http_backend_process: passed; a new backend process on a separate local port returned HTTP 200 for health and the persisted test household; the temporary process was shut down after verification

feature_limitations_not_regressions: Custom chore creation is not implemented; current chores are seeded and completion is persisted.
Expense creation and payment-status management are not implemented; Bills & Rent displays the seeded read-only summaries and splits.
Demo profile switching is not production authentication and cannot prove which person cast a vote.
